title: Says “mehaq”
description: Gyani Maiya Sen-Kusunda says "mehaq" in Kusunda. It literally means "ban-raja" (forest king) and is a name for a Kusunda person. The clip is cut from a 2018 recording that Subhashish Panigrahi made for his documentary Gyani Maiya (2019, 2023). In that interview, Uday Raj Aaley asked her questions in Nepali, based on broader questions by Panigrahi, and she answered mostly in Kusunda and sometimes in Nepali.
